title: Try Speedometer Live Wallpaper online: car dashboard demo
description: Try the Speedometer live wallpaper in your browser: every car dashboard style live, with your real GPS speed, battery and clock. Then get it on Google Play.

social.title: Try Speedometer Live Wallpaper online
social.description: The real live wallpaper, running in your browser: every car dashboard style, with your real speed, battery and clock.
social.imageAlt: Speedometer Live Wallpaper: a phone on a car's dashboard at night, showing the Amber Night gauges at 87 km/h, with rain and city lights on the windscreen

@graph.name: Speedometer Live Wallpaper, online demo
@graph.description: The Speedometer live wallpaper running in the browser: every car dashboard style, its layouts and settings, with the browser's real clock, battery and GPS speed where it has them, and a demo drive for the rest.
@graph.operatingSystem: Any, in a browser with WebAssembly
@graph.browserRequirements: Requires WebAssembly with garbage collection: Chrome or Edge 119, Firefox 120, Safari 18.2 or later

hero.title: Try Speedometer Live Wallpaper online
hero.lead: Your phone's dashboard, live in your browser.

sections.title: Try the car dashboard wallpaper
sections.intro: This is the real live wallpaper: the code that draws it on your phone draws it here. Pick a style, try its layouts and colours, change the settings and tap the big gauge. The premium styles are fully live too.

qr.alt: A QR code that opens Speedometer Live Wallpaper on Google Play

labels.screen: Speedometer Live Wallpaper, live: tap the big gauge to switch it
labels.gauge: Tap the big gauge to switch between power, CPU clock and speed, as on your phone.
labels.getNote: A browser can’t set your wallpaper. Get the app on Google Play, open Styles and pick this one.
labels.unlock: Each premium style is €0.99, once, or unlock them all for €4.99.

sections.title: Real readings, where your browser has them
sections.intro: The demo feeds the wallpaper the same readings your phone would, through the app's own code, so units, clocks and warning lights behave as they do in the app.

items.title: The clock
items.text: Your browser's own time, in your time zone, with your 12 or 24-hour clock.

items.title: Your battery
items.text: Its level and charging, in Chrome, Edge and Samsung Internet. Safari and Firefox show the demo's.

items.title: Your real speed
items.text: Tap Use my real speed and allow your location. It stays in your browser. Watch it only as a passenger.

items.title: A demo drive for the rest
items.text: Power, CPU clock, RAM, signal, Bluetooth and the music come from a 26-second drive, as in the app's previews.

cta.title: Put the dashboard on your phone
cta.text: Free on Google Play, for Android phones and tablets, with every style you tried here.
